How to order

Four simple steps

  1. 01

    Pick your design

    Open Explore, choose Hoodies and pick your design, 001 to 004.

  2. 02

    Add your details

    Name, contact, batch and size. Add custom text for ₹60 if you want it printed.

  3. 03

    Pay and upload

    Scan the QR, pay the exact amount and upload your payment screenshot.

  4. 04

    Get your receipt

    Save your order ID. Your order is recorded and we will take it from there.

Good to Know: All hoodies will be delivered together in one bulk shipment to your batch. Please collect your hoodie from the designated collection point. Thank you for your understanding!
